tracks.title: Helt fra start
tracks.summary: Start from zero: the letters and sounds of Norwegian, saying hello and who you are, numbers and prices, the shop, signs in the street, the café and telling the time.

tracks.title: De første ukene i Norge
tracks.summary: The situations of your first weeks: the first workday, the tax card, BankID, renting, the doctor and lunch with colleagues.

tracks.title: Ekte tekster
tracks.summary: Real kinds of documents, simplified to your level: a letter from NAV, a second-hand ad, a job ad and a notice from the housing association.

tracks.title: Hverdagen i Oslo
tracks.summary: Everyday errands and social life: the pharmacy, picking up a parcel, weather and clothes, a dinner invitation, booking a haircut and a job interview.

tracks.title: Mer av hverdagen
tracks.summary: More of daily life: emergency numbers and the emergency clinic, sorting rubbish, messages to colleagues, eating out with an allergy, describing a new colleague, the dentist, reporting a move and a new mobile plan.

tracks.title: Videre mot B1
tracks.summary: The next step: talking about what you did, writing to your landlord, meeting minutes, a yearly review at work, a kindergarten letter and a news text about Easter.

tracks.title: Arbeidslivet
tracks.summary: Working life at B1: your contract, the payslip and holiday pay, giving your opinion in a meeting, safety rules, asking for holiday, handling an unhappy customer and the office Christmas party.

tracks.title: Samfunnet rundt deg
tracks.summary: Norwegian society at B1: the tax return, a parent meeting, parental leave, a noisy neighbour, a product complaint, electricity prices in the news, 17 May, the right to roam and Christmas.
